model_validation.scope: Published 0.1.11 Torch/FLA baseline only; does not validate the new MoE, Graph or quantized paths
model_validation.conclusion: No clear FLA end-to-end benefit on this RAM-expert configuration

moe_acceleration.requirements: Supported NVRTC CUDA kernels, pinned host memory and sufficient RAM; otherwise Torch with a recorded reason
moe_acceleration.end_to_end_validation: In progress; no general speed or content-quality claim

quantized_numerical_tests.scope: INT8/W6/W4 packed operators, cache, Graph replay and 4-layer INT8 CPU/GPU handoff; not whole-model acceptance

cuda_graph.requires: Synchronization-free expert backend on one CUDA device, compatible host lifecycle

kernel_state_rng_tests.scope: Kernel/state/RNG tests including first-replay cross-stream race; not full model or canvas certification

cuda_graph.recoverable_failure: Record capture rejection and run the operation eagerly when capture_end completed safely
cuda_graph.invalidated_process: Reject further inference; restart the host and disable cuda_graph for that configuration
